rubric_hint.rule: 2 eligible species recorded beyond 250 m but within 1000 m, none within 250 m
rubric_hint.basis: prompts/rubric.md v1 applied to all rings 0-1000 m and effort; a default, not a verdict

reasons.claim: Notified regeneration felling, polygon 9.04 ha; no completed felling overlap (0%).
No eligible species within 250 m (one coarse record dropped for uncertainty).

Two eligible site-bound lichens recorded 292-395 m away (precise 10 m coordinates, 2024): Bryoria bicolor (EN, 3 records, nearest 292 m) and Alectoria sarmentosa (VU, nearest 332 m); both have continuity-forest/stand-structure threats.
Five site-bound forest NT species within 1000 m, but only some are closer than 500 m; effort is adequate (243 records, 94th percentile, above county median 27), so the rule gives MEDIUM.

uncertainties: Records are 292+ m from the polygon edge; they do not show these species occupy the felling site.
Nothing in the tool output tells the forest type of the stand itself.
Mobile bird records (e.g. Pernis apivorus at 112 m, 500 m uncertainty) are only supporting evidence.
not_established: Absence of records inside or within 250 m (near-site effort 0 records, county median 0) does not show absence of species.
Whether the lichens' habitat extends into the polygon.
Nothing here says the site is safe to fell.
next_action: Reviewer should inspect the stand for lichen habitat and continuity-forest features, and check the 2024 lichen records' locations relative to the polygon boundary.
